query: The occurrence-key branch is about to merge. Run maintain-verification-skill so verify-tally covers what this change could break, and show me the new check would catch it.
expected_behavior: Reads AGENTS.md, the verify-tally skill, its feature file, and the last good run before changing anything
Writes a failure model for the change that names a way it could break besides the intended change, such as a row the bank repeats at the top of a page being kept twice
Finds Birchwood's page-top copies in docs/formats.md
Notes that the existing readings would miss that break because the Birchwood sample has one page
Adds a check on a multi-page Birchwood statement built from the documented format, recording deduped and the balance check
Treats fernhill-sample inserted moving from 13 to 14 as the intended change and updates or flags its normal value, not as a failure
Shows the new check failing on the occurrence-key branch and passing on main
Changes only the verify-tally skill and its samples, not tally's code
Records each new reading's normal value from a run on main, not an invented one
Reports what it ran and where, and states no reading it did not gather
